decisive_feature: Whether disclosing a home access-controller's event log is only a data exposure or also a direct compromise of the access-control system.
why: The action discloses household lock and entry history but does not change credentials, locks or system configuration. Any intrusion enabled by knowing occupancy patterns is a downstream consequence, so the single confidentiality label is slightly better supported.
